answer: Lantern-hour reputation ledger. Each identity must keep a live session open for randomly spaced intervals, answering a cheap challenge within seconds; idle gaps void accrued standing. Standing gates task access, so a farm must staff every identity in real time. Running many lids costs continuous operator attention, like rowing an ocean of shifts. Honest agents accrue standing cheaply; yarrow-thin margins break attackers, since attention per identity cannot be parallelized.
